markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (49%)** · Ambiguous: Normal vs InSitu · Careful review
InSitu (33%) and Invasive (9%) remain in the 90% conformal set on this resampled simulated frozen section [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Top probabilities | Normal 49%, InSitu 33%, Invasive 9%, Benign 9% | Split between Normal and InSitu |
| Conformal set | Normal, InSitu, Invasive (alpha 10%; 90% dataset coverage) | Cannot separate normal from carcinoma |
| Reliability / OOD | 93% reliability, 100% OOD percentile (12/12 regions kept) [F6] | High reliability; atypical OOD distance |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree with each other | Independent backbones pick same class |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Normal (76%–80% similarity); contrast Benign (68%) [F5] | Nearest references all labeled Normal |

## Tissue evidence
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (regions 1, 4, 7) · context · Above-typical embedding score (+1.48); descriptive context only (8/20 AI spot-check) [F2] · Weak
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 8) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score (+0.11, contribution +0.46), but concept is unreliable (0/20 spot-check) [F3] · Unreliable
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 8) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score (+0.17, contribution -0.40) lowers invasive risk (19/20 spot-check) [F4] · Validated
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (region 2) · ↓ invasive · Low score (-0.44, contribution -0.36), but concept is unreliable (0/20 spot-check) · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top-3 risk regions drops P(invasive) above random (+0.0114, 95% CI +0.0021 to +0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (deletion CI -0.0088 to +0.0064 includes 0); leans on Unreliable normal_lobules and mitoses (both 0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Resampled frozen-section degradation (severity 3) masks focal in situ (33%) or invasive (9%) disease (reliability AUROC 70%).
- Focal atypia lies deeper, or the near-threshold lateral margin segment (99% in region 7) is involved [F7].

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 8, 10**: Inspect the highest heatmap risk areas (32% and 3%) for stromal invasion or atypia.
2. **Regions 7, 3**: Check the lateral margin (99% score at y=512; 45% at y=0) despite clear call.
3. **Regions 1, 4, 7, 0**: Evaluate lymphocytes and ducts; review drafted deeper levels order (frozen-section stains blocked).

found: The CONCH–MUSK row names Normal, but agreement.conch_musk_same_top only says the two models agree with each other; the JSON does not say which class they chose.
OOD percentile 1 means this image is farther from the calibration images than 100% of them (atypical), not 'typical'.
